title: How does hazard exposure influence job choice? Evaluating time-dependent tradeoffs between salary and hazard risks
abstract: arXiv:2608.24811v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural hazards are a nonmarket disamenity that affects an individual's search for employment resulting in a negative environmental impact that produces an economic inefficiency. We develop a seek-and-screen job search approach that uses a discrete choice simulation to examine how salary, crime, and natural hazard risk influence job choice. We model the job decision process as a series of elimination events using a Cox hazard model grounded in a Random Utility Model. We use data from the discrete choice simulation to estimate both a standard proportional hazards model and an extended specification that allows the effect of natural hazard risk to vary across decision rounds. Individuals are exposed to the dynamics of a simulated job search as they make decisions between pairs of job offers in an adaptive learning process based on income, geography, crime level, and natural hazard attributes. translated_title: 自然灾害风险如何影响职业选择？评估薪资与灾害风险之间的时间依赖性权衡
translated_abstract: 自然灾害是一种非市场性不利因素，影响个人的求职过程，产生负面环境影响并导致经济效率低下。我们开发了一种“搜索-筛选”求职方法，使用离散选择模拟来考察薪资、犯罪和自然灾害风险如何影响职业选择。我们将职业决策过程建模为一系列淘汰事件，基于随机效用模型使用Cox风险模型进行分析。我们利用离散选择模拟的数据估计了标准比例风险模型和一个扩展规格，该规格允许自然灾害风险的影响在不同决策轮次中变化。个体在模拟求职的动态过程中，基于收入、地理位置、犯罪水平和自然灾害属性，在成对的职位提供之间进行自适应学习决策。职业选择决策的结果提供了相关见解。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合Cox风险模型和离散选择模拟的求职决策方法，首次揭示了自然灾害风险对职业选择的影响随时间动态变化，并发现薪资与灾害风险之间的权衡关系在不同决策阶段具有非对称性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a job search decision method combining Cox hazard modeling and discrete choice simulation, first revealing that natural hazard risk's influence on job choice varies dynamically over time, with asymmetric tradeoffs between salary and hazard risks across decision stages.
